study.question: Does valid-event task-mask assignment retain conditional click utility when only the variance component of primary scorer population-normalization gradients is retained, beyond counts and a valid-history membership permutation, and does this explain the reversal after detaching both moments?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the entry utility control g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative has click AUC 0.6689612705559688 versus adapted DIN 0.6555440824200336. The native uniform-auxiliary bridge g1-r0085-membership_native_uniform_bridge has AUC 0.6688899334122161; its matched native counts control g1-r0081-membership_counts_uniform_aux has 0.6688764855097781 and permuted control g1-r0084-membership_permuted_native_uniform has 0.6688160817483072. Those full advantages are only 0.0000134479024380 and 0.0000738516639089. Detaching both primary scorer moment derivatives gives full/counts/permuted AUC 0.6678477774019909 / 0.6678920925595836 / 0.6679308764614110, reversing both rankings. Row-local normalization with uniform auxiliary readout instead makes full, counts and permuted exactly equal at 0.6677354125015613 in the recorded seed. These endpoints do not distinguish mean from variance derivatives. Prospective mechanism hypothesis: content-dependent variance-gradient coupling may suffice to recover some assignment utility without the mean-gradient broadcast. For normalized hidden population z=(X-mu)*r, r=(biased_var+eps)^(-1/2), the ordinary ideal input VJP is r*(g-mean(g)-z*mean(g*z)); retain r*(g-z*mean(g*z)) while keeping native forward values. This is a first-order surrogate VJP diagnostic, not the ordinary derivative of reported BCE and not a proposed novel architecture. The alternative that both terms must interact remains open. The inspected pinned loader derives each task-mask bit deterministically from action-vocabulary tokens; these masks therefore add an inductive grouping of existing action information, not a separately observed signal. The inherited implementation uses the union of cart/fav/buy membership, not four independent learned task assignments. Local evidence is single-seed; deterministic bridges are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules: an explicit full-VJP/full-membership numerical bridge, then full/counts/permuted membership with variance-only VJP. Every training call first executes original layer.bn once and returns its unchanged normalized values. Detached FP32 mean and biased variance define the explicit VJP; both mean and variance components are computed in every arm. All explicit modes cast once at the hidden input boundary. Evaluation returns original Dice directly. No parameters, buffers, RNG calls, labels or sample inputs are added. The native kernel saved statistics/reduction ordering are unavailable through the supported module API, so recomputed moments need not yield an identical BF16 backward. The explicit full bridge is essential before cross-round normalization attribution. New-arm comparisons among membership representations remain matched even if that bridge fails. The codes expose native and detached modes for diagnostics but only the four registered configurations are requested; any extra execution would consume budget. Local preparation passed compile/AST checks, import and configuration checks, unchanged-function and ancestor-hash audits. Independent scalar finite differences of the ideal full and variance-only formulas passed nonconstant, constant and singleton populations (maximum absolute error 2.61e-10 at diagnostic epsilon 0.05). This checks the algebra only, not PyTorch implementation, actual eps=1e-9, BF16, masking or training. No tensor forward/backward, host training, raw-data read or held-out assessment was executed.
predictions: Numerical bridge: membership_full_explicit_bridge should approach g1-r0085-membership_native_uniform_bridge (AUC 0.6688899334122161, Logloss 0.18190290678041504). Prespecified numerical comparability gate: absolute AUC difference <=0.00001 and absolute click Logloss difference <=0.00001. This is a sensitivity gate, not a statistical significance threshold. A failure blocks attributing differences from prior native/detached endpoints to one derivative component.

Variance-gradient sufficiency predicts membership_full_variance_only exceeds both membership_counts_variance_only and membership_permuted_variance_only on full validation click AUC; ideally its two assignment margins have the native-uniform direction rather than the detached reversal. Compare the matched difference-in-differences against prior native and detached margins, explicitly conditional on the bridge gate.

At identical frozen parameters, normalization-choice variants have identical forward values and one running-state update per native Dice invocation; only learned trajectories may diverge. The same learned parameter count 32192421 (31793216 embedding, 399205 dense) is expected in each arm and must be measured by host.

Record all four tasks AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, training/wall/allocated GPU time if supplied, peak memory and model-only whole-batch inference p50/p95/throughput. Previous related runs were about 447-474 wall seconds, ~3.07 GB peak GPU allocation and ~29.8-32.0 inference seconds. New overhead is unmeasured; no equal-compute efficiency claim follows from matched epochs.

History-length bins are pre-existing empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64. Report samples, positives and negatives, deriving negatives from samples-positives. Slices are exploratory for this mechanism. No claimed independent repeated support without paired seeds and user-cluster uncertainty through an authorized interface.
falsifiers: Full variance-only failing to beat either matched counts-only or valid-history permutation undermines variance-gradient sufficiency for conditional membership utility in this tested route; it does not establish that membership is universally useless.

A bridge failure, nonfinite host forward/backward, changed state-update count, padded-event dependence, changed label construction, unanticipated parameter mismatch or information-boundary violation invalidates the corresponding interpretation. Preserve failed receipts and charged costs; do not silently repair frozen host contracts.

If only the explicit full bridge retains the full-membership advantage while variance-only loses it, the variance term alone is insufficient. A mean-only versus full control would be the next falsifiable question; it is not answered by this suite.

A result explained by count frequency, a count-preserving membership permutation, extra capacity or measured cost cannot establish useful event assignment. A tiny single-seed gain without uncertainty and independent paired repetitions remains provisional.
A material whole-model loss relative to the unchanged entry utility control without discriminating attribution is a negative scientific outcome, not a new best model.
alternative_explanations: Mean and variance gradient terms may interact; this suite tests sufficiency of variance coupling and omits the reciprocal mean-only arm to retain both grouping controls and a numerical bridge within the four-variant limit.

FP32 recomputation, BF16 casts, epsilon sensitivity and cancellation differ from native BatchNorm saved-statistics kernels. The bridge quantifies aggregate sensitivity but cannot prove bitwise gradient equivalence or correct custom-autograd execution.

Primary scorer normalization couples summary rows across users and temporal blocks, including zero summary rows. Support multiplicity, sparse-gradient accumulation, AdamW/Adagrad trajectories and the inherited auxiliary-context surrogate VJP may mediate the effect. No parameter-space or clean causal event-information claim follows.

The valid-rank half-cycle preserves all per-task counts and joint task-bit patterns within each valid temporal block, but also preserves event order of the content and cannot eliminate correlations induced by homogeneous blocks. Counts-only preserves auxiliary-union block mass and empty-row patterns while replacing both grouped means by the valid uniform mean; it does not remove action content.

All auxiliary heads share the uniform base in this suite, unlike the strongest entry utility control. Prior uniform-auxiliary controls motivate this route closure; conclusions must remain conditional on it.

Model-selection noise on reused validation data, one frozen seed, repeated exposures per user and unequal runtime overhead can explain small margins. Offline feedback maturation and publisher whole-window vocab/static snapshots limit production transfer.
